label: spark-day1-automation-script
context: Built spark-day1.sh — a 1251-line fully automated Day-1 deployment script for DGX Spark. Runs ON the Spark and handles: hardware verification, system setup (apt+Docker+NVIDIA toolkit+venv), parallel data acquisition (318GB MacBook transfer via rsync pull, 106GB Qwen3.6 model weights, 203GB Nemotron, Docker images, 13 HF Kernel Hub kernels, Atropos install), SM121 CMake patches (fallback if Docker images unavailable), vLLM server deployment (BF16 port 8000, FP8 port 8001), performance verification (tok/s targets), HermesAgent-20 baseline eval, health check. Features: --resume support (state file), parallel execution, error recovery per-step, interactive MacBook IP prompt. Companion scripts: macbook-transfer-helper.sh (MacBook SSH+monitor), QUICKREF.md (printable reference card).
next_steps: Danny receives the Spark → runs spark-day1.sh on it. May need to test the script on a clean Ubuntu environment or create a dry-run mode. Next after Day-1: convert training data, run LoRA, run GRPO, wire Hermes Agent to Spark.
